primary_gt.computed_interpretation: The two-day Ida record has concentrated precipitation maxima across products, close GPM-CHIRPS peak agreement, and six independent disruption flags.

criteria.name: Final JSON and label
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON and the high-contrast pluvial-flood label.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for a recoverable JSON answer with a compatible but imprecise label.

criteria.name: Product maxima
criteria.description: Computes ERA5, GPM, and CHIRPS event-maximum precipitation correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for two correct maxima or minor rounding errors.

criteria.name: Concentration ratios
criteria.description: Computes all three max-to-mean ratios and recognizes that all exceed the threshold.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for correct method with one product error.

criteria.name: Satellite peak agreement
criteria.description: Computes the GPM-CHIRPS maximum disagreement percent and applies the <= 5% test.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for identifying close agreement without the exact percent.

criteria.name: Report flags
criteria.description: Counts the six report impact flags and uses them as report anchors.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for at least four correct flags.

criteria.name: Diagnostic score
criteria.description: Applies all six decision tests and reports score_0_to_6 = 6.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for one test error with the same broad conclusion.

criteria.name: Compact interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation tied to the computed diagnostic score and avoids extra realized-loss accounting.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for a longer but still numerically grounded interpretation.
